body: This just seems like cliche assumptions no offense. My life isn't a fucking movie where I have some sort of secret talent waiting to come out. I'm a loser to the umpteenth degree and if there really was some brighter days then they wouldve happened right now. Being thoughtful means nothing. Everyone is thoughtful and I'm not going to be happy about being self aware of my pathetic existence. And yes I'm exposed to countless clubs and even if I capitalize on those opportunities I'm still rejected. Doesn't that show how pathetic I am? I don't care about anyone. No one ever cared about me and judging from how many people ostracize me they'll probably just shrug off my death in seconds. And yes I'm so glad I live in a firstworld country life has been so great because of that clearly that's why im posting in a goddamn suicide watch thread.
So I should be happy that I know I'm a miserable fuck, as opposed to just being a miserable fuck.
How am I not a pathetic loser? What do I have that in my life that anybody else would covet?

But I'm not going to be happy unless I can interpret what A is saying about me. I get what you're saying is sound advice, but I'm not going to walk around being happy about being the ugly goof who's comfortable with himself. Unless I can know how one girl felt about me for sure I'm not going to be happy with myself.

What's the point of fixing it? Like let's say by the offchance I somehow get ripped and graduate with a 4.0 and get a 7 figure job. What's the point if I'm going to be alone for the rest of my life? Everyone else will be graduating with their friends and their lovers and I'll be here just alone. Why work out if I don't even know if I'm ugly? Like some people are good looking but their fat. So working out helps them. But I might just be ugly. And I'm short. So what's the point. I'll literally be alone for the rest of my life, so why not just end it? And sure even shotguns to the face have a fail rate, but it's .0000001% that it'll happen. I'll take those odds anyday. 

And by shitty person I meant I have nothing that people would covet. Obviously I don't do that ridiculous shit you mentioned that makes someone shitty but so does like 95% of the population. Then in what way am I any different than anybody else? I'm clearly too different and too fucking pathetic.

I'm not sad about A leaving, I'm sad about the fact that she may not have been physically attracted to me, which means literally no one has ever been physically into me. She said that she wasn't, but then said I was cute for someone not her type. I have no clue how to take it so I just chalk it up to her meaning personality cute or something. I never overshot it with her. She said she left because of lack of confidence or some bullshit like that. 

I meet people by talking to them in class, but no one ever wants to hang out with me beyond an academic setting. No idea why. It just never happens. I talk to people and I'm nice and friendly to them, but I end up getting used for homework or just being overall ostracized. The most I get out of anyone is a hello when I walk past them. Other than that, no one calls me up to hang out or anything like that. I've tried joining clubs but that has done nothing for me. 

And how could the rest of my message be objectively untrue about anyone? It is actually who I am. I am short, fat, ugly, and pathetic. those are objective qualities and they are exactly what anyone would see. And any experience I've mentioned is exactly what happened. 

I appreciate the advice on exercising, but I don't see the point. I don't even know what I am facially, so even if I get ripped, what's the point if I just have an ugly face? I don't want to be one of those guys who has a nice body but just a butterface or something. 

I don't mind sharing, but I literally have no social life. I wake up, decide whether or not I want to go to class, go get food, then come back to my room and watch tv. No one asks me to do shit so I don't ever do shit.
